_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Neutral coil (flat funding, F&G mid-range, limited 30d drift) keeps score on/near this rung; HOLD is the base-rate call until volatility or flow expansion breaks it.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicitly HOLD into Complacency; narrative supplies no forward phase but describes non-panic price action compatible with coil
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 45-55, funding near flat, BTC remains rangebound without vol expansion
next_move.invalidated_if: reserves-led long unwind with ETF flows ~0 drives F&G below 40, or flow rebound pushes F&G above 60
